dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge follows a concave spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small radius, rounded apex with an acute angle formed by the converging margins.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin exhibits a steep positive slope of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height ratio is approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Melon exhibits a large-radius, smooth convex curvature transitioning from the blowhole region to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby anterior protrusion with a low length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon curvature meets the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform monochromatic cyan coloration across the entire anatomical surface.
